items.html: And these hairs are the aspect of rivers of water, drawn from the great sea of the Hochma, the hidden Mocha; for they are channels that draw the waters and go out through their mouths, and afterwards are drawn to Ima, Bina, and give into her as well, in the manner of female waters (Mayin Nukvin) — the five Gevurot of the final letters (Mantzeptach) that are in her, as is known. For Aba and Ima are included in this mazal [lock] of the beard, and through it they couple (mizdavegin), as was said. And this is the secret of "The voice of many waters, mighty, are the breakers of the sea...", as is explained in its place, on the verse.
